text: Then he washed in a river: from his left eye came Amaterasu, the sun goddess and ancestor of the four brothers, from his right the moon god, and from his nose Susanoo, god of storms.
spoken: Then he washed in a river: from his left eye came Ah-mah-teh-rah-soo, the sun goddess and ancestor of the four brothers, from his right the moon god, and from his nose Soo-sah-no-oh, god of storms.

pauzy.regula: przecinek, po samogłosce, krótkie słowo (1 syl.)
